data.title: Content Trialled Before Amplification
data.summary:
Variants of the campaign's central claim appeared in low-reach settings before the
version that was eventually amplified, indicating the message was tested and selected.
data.description:
Testing is a strong indicator of a resourced operation and a useful forecasting tool. The
variants that were tried and discarded show what the operator believes its audience
responds to, and the one selected shows what worked.

The discarded variants are frequently still recoverable — deleted posts persist in
archives and in quote-replies — and they are among the most analytically valuable
artefacts available, because they reveal intent more plainly than the polished version.

Where testing is observed, expect the next phase to be tested too. The organisation can
use the same signal as an early warning if it keeps watching the low-reach space rather
than only the amplified one.
data.recommendation:
* Preserve discarded variants; they evidence deliberation and are usually deleted.
* Monitor the low-reach space where testing occurred as an early-warning channel for the
  next phase.
* Prepare responses to the tested variants, not only to the one currently circulating.
data.short_recommendation: Preserve tested variants and watch the test channel for the next phase.
